faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for Allahabad High Court Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 5 December 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How do I apply for Allahabad High Court Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Prescribed proforma enclosed with the Vacancy Circular File No. A-12026/15/2022-CESTAT-DOR dated 02.11.2026) and send it to the address given in the notification, to reach by 5 December 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for Allahabad High Court Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Willing and eligible Judicial Officers (as per the Vacancy Circular) who have retired or are going to retire within the next six months, i.e. up to 31.05.2027. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.
